name: Tantei Tomamechi Kensuke Futsuu wa Kou Da ze!
original_name: 探偵・苫米地研介 普通はこうだぜ!
source:
A woman strangled to death was found in the apartment where Tomamechi Kensuke lives. The detective is asked by the manager to launch an investigation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-april-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
